_doc: Wave-4 Specialization trees (Fable, 2026-11-11; design in docs/SPECS.md "Wave 4"; the roster in data/specs.json). Six specs - Wyrmblood (Fighter), Tinker (Rogue), Chronomancer (Mage) and the hybrids Spirit Speaker (Healer OR Mage), Hexbreaker (Rogue OR Healer) and Monk (Fighter OR Rogue) - three trees each, 10 nodes a tree, levels 10/11/12/14/16/18/20, ranks to 10 (short utilities 3-5). SAME SCHEMA as skills-specs-1/2/3.json. HYBRIDS: every Hexbreaker active carries `altCost` in mana (from Healer) and every Monk active `altCost` in temper (from Fighter); the Spirit Speaker's two Paths both pay mana, so no altCost (as the Druid). STANCES THAT SWAP THE BAR: the Wyrmblood's Fire and Frost Tempers and its capstone Wyrm Ascendant (a 15 s storm temper) carry `bar: [6 ids]` as wave 3's shapes do - a temper sets the element and the bar; Wyrmfall sits on every bar, and one hidden active (wyr_storm_breath, reqLevel 20, maxRank 1, no tree) exists only on the storm bar. The Monk's Inner Stillness is a stance WITHOUT a bar (stats only). STATIONARY MINIONS (`stay: true` on a summon, landed with the wave-3 engine work): the Tinker's four sentries and siege engine and the Spirit Speaker's Striking Post and Great Post stand where they are put (target: ground, so they land at the pointer) and shoot from there; a Mending / Rooting / Cleansing Post is a `zone` (zones already reach companions). `chain` on a bolt (Spirit Bolt jumps twice, A Thousand Spirits five times). `cond: { slowed }` on Frost Rend, Winter Heart, Unravel and Heat Death. POISE is the Swashbuckler's flair trick: every Monk strike ends with `buff damage 3% 8 s` filed under its own skill id, so different strikes stack and the same one only refreshes; Ninefold Staff reads the sum like any weapon hit. NUMBERS as waves 1-3. Everything here runs on the engine today except the ideas in `wishlist`, each written as its fallback.

wyr_fire_temper.name: Fire Temper
wyr_fire_temper.desc: Take the burning temper: +10% damage and +5% critical chance, and your six slots become the fire breath, rend and rush while it holds. Press again to cool; one temper at a time.

wyr_fire_breath.name: Fire Breath
wyr_fire_breath.desc: Breathe fire over everything in front of you: {dmg} fire damage in a 90 degree cone, and all of it burns for 6 seconds.

wyr_hotter_breath.name: Hotter Breath
wyr_hotter_breath.desc: Fire Breath burns harder per rank.

wyr_fire_rend.name: Fire Rend
wyr_fire_rend.desc: Claws that burn: {mult} weapon damage and the target burns for 8 seconds. The fire temper's filler.

wyr_cinder_rush.name: Cinder Rush
wyr_cinder_rush.desc: Rush 10 m at the target in a trail of cinders and land burning: {dmg} fire damage to everything within 4 m of you.

wyr_long_burn.name: Long Burn
wyr_long_burn.desc: Fire Rend burns longer per rank.

wyr_pyre_heart.name: Pyre Heart
wyr_pyre_heart.desc: Let the furnace out: {dmg} fire damage to everything within 6 m, more the more it hits (up to +40%), all of it burning for 8 seconds, and you hit 20% harder for 10. The Fire Temper capstone.

wyr_frost_temper.name: Frost Temper
wyr_frost_temper.desc: Take the cold temper: +15% armour and +5 dodge, and your six slots become the frost breath, rend and slam while it holds. Press again to thaw; one temper at a time.

wyr_frost_breath.name: Frost Breath
wyr_frost_breath.desc: Breathe frost over everything in front of you: {dmg} frost damage in a 90 degree cone and a 40% slow for 4 seconds.

wyr_wider_breath.name: Wider Breath
wyr_wider_breath.desc: Frost Breath reaches further per rank.

wyr_frost_rend.name: Frost Rend
wyr_frost_rend.desc: Claws of ice: {mult} weapon damage, a 30% slow for 3 seconds, and a bite of frost that is half again as hard on anything already slowed, held or stunned. The frost temper's filler.

wyr_glacier_slam.name: Glacier Slam
wyr_glacier_slam.desc: Both claws down: {mult} weapon damage and a 2 second hold on the target, and ice over 4 m round it that hurts and slows.

wyr_deeper_frost.name: Deeper Frost
wyr_deeper_frost.desc: Frost Rend bites harder per rank.

wyr_winter_heart.name: Winter Heart
wyr_winter_heart.desc: The cold comes out of you: {dmg} frost damage to everything within 8 m, half again on anything slowed, a 2 second hold on all of it, and a {dmg} ward on you. The Frost Temper capstone.

wyr_dragonscale.name: Dragonscale
wyr_dragonscale.desc: Harden the scales: a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds that throws storm back at whatever hits you, and +15% armour while it holds. Works in any temper.

wyr_wyrmfall.name: Wyrmfall
wyr_wyrmfall.desc: Leap 12 m and come down on the target: {mult} weapon damage to everything within 4 m of where you land and a short stun. On every temper's bar.

wyr_jaw_snap.name: Jaw Snap
wyr_jaw_snap.desc: Snap at the words: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {mult} weapon damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

wyr_harder_scales.name: Harder Scales
wyr_harder_scales.desc: Dragonscale wards for more per rank.

wyr_tail_sweep.name: Tail Sweep
wyr_tail_sweep.desc: A sweep of the tail through a 150 degree arc: {mult} weapon damage and everything in it knocked 3 m back.

wyr_ascendant.name: Wyrm Ascendant
wyr_ascendant.desc: The third temper, storm, for 15 seconds: +15% damage, +8% crit, +20% armour, 15% faster, a bar of the storm breath, both rends, Wyrmfall and Tail Sweep, and a thunderclap for {dmg} storm damage that stuns everything within 8 m as you rise. The Scales capstone.

wyr_storm_breath.name: Storm Breath
wyr_storm_breath.desc: Breathe lightning over everything in front of you: {dmg} storm damage in a 90 degree cone and a half-second stun. Yours while the storm temper holds.

tnk_clockwork_bolt.name: Clockwork Bolt
tnk_clockwork_bolt.desc: A bolt that goes off twice: {mult} weapon damage, then a charge of {dmg} storm damage a moment later. Your filler.

tnk_flask_grenade.name: Flask Grenade
tnk_flask_grenade.desc: Lob a flask of burning oil: {dmg} fire damage to everything within 4 m of where it lands, and all of it burns for 5 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

tnk_tighter_spring.name: Tighter Spring
tnk_tighter_spring.desc: Clockwork Bolt hits harder per rank.

tnk_frost_flask.name: Frost Flask
tnk_frost_flask.desc: The other flask: {dmg} frost damage to everything within 4 m of where it lands and a 40% slow for 4 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

tnk_scattershot.name: Scattershot
tnk_scattershot.desc: A spread of bolts through a 60 degree cone: {mult} weapon damage to everything in it, more the more it hits (up to +40%). Needs a crossbow or bow.

tnk_bigger_flask.name: Bigger Flask
tnk_bigger_flask.desc: Flask Grenade covers more ground per rank.

tnk_overwound_bolt.name: Overwound Bolt
tnk_overwound_bolt.desc: Wound too far: two bolts for {mult} weapon damage each and a charge of {dmg} storm damage behind them.

tnk_clockwork_barrage.name: Clockwork Barrage
tnk_clockwork_barrage.desc: Three seconds of everything the gun has: each second a bolt for {mult} weapon damage, a storm charge, and a flask bursting for fire over 3 m round the target. The Clockwork capstone.

tnk_deploy_sentry.name: Deploy Sentry
tnk_deploy_sentry.desc: Set a sentry down where you point: a crossbow on legs that stands where it is put and shoots whatever you fight for {secs} seconds. Counts as a minion (up to eight). Ranks make it tougher and sharper.

tnk_flame_sentry.name: Flame Sentry
tnk_flame_sentry.desc: A sentry with a burner on it: it throws fire and, when they bunch up, a gout over 3 m. Stands where it is put for {secs} seconds; counts as a minion.

tnk_bait_sentry.name: Bait Sentry
tnk_bait_sentry.desc: A tin soldier that bangs a drum: everything within 6 m of it turns on it for {secs} seconds or until it is smashed. Stands where it is put; counts as a minion.

tnk_twin_sentries.name: Twin Sentries
tnk_twin_sentries.desc: Two sentries at once where you point, for {secs} seconds. They count as minions.

tnk_hotter_burner.name: Hotter Burner
tnk_hotter_burner.desc: The Flame Sentry burns harder per rank.

tnk_siege_engine.name: Siege Engine
tnk_siege_engine.desc: Bolt the big one together where you point: a siege engine that stands where it is put for {secs} seconds, shoots hard and lobs fire over a crowd. It is your pet, not a minion, so the sentries stay. The Sentries capstone.

tnk_grapple_line.name: Grapple Line
tnk_grapple_line.desc: Fire the line and reel yourself 12 m to the target, landing a cut for {mult} weapon damage.

tnk_pocket_watch.name: Pocket Watch
tnk_pocket_watch.desc: Wind the watch: {dmg} healing on yourself now and a little more every second for 8. Instant.

tnk_spring_battery.name: Spring Battery
tnk_spring_battery.desc: Plug the party in: everyone casts 20% faster and runs 20% faster for 10 seconds.

tnk_better_watch.name: Better Watch
tnk_better_watch.desc: Pocket Watch heals for more per rank.

tnk_smoke_canister.name: Smoke Canister
tnk_smoke_canister.desc: A canister where you point: everything within 4 m is slowed 50% and hits 20% softer for 4 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

tnk_jammer.name: Jammer
tnk_jammer.desc: A screech from a box: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} storm damage. From 20 m; does not use the global cooldown.

tnk_overclock.name: Overclock
tnk_overclock.desc: Every spring at once: for 12 seconds you hit 20% harder, crit 15% more and cast 25% faster, 40 energy comes back, and a {dmg} ward goes up. The Contraptions capstone.

chr_quick_bolt.name: Quick Bolt
chr_quick_bolt.desc: A bolt that was already on its way: {dmg} storm damage in a one second cast. Your filler.

chr_quicken.name: Quicken
chr_quicken.desc: Borrow from the next ten seconds: you cast 25% faster and move 20% faster for 10.

chr_sharper_tick.name: Sharper Tick
chr_sharper_tick.desc: Quick Bolt hits harder per rank.

chr_second_hand.name: Second Hand
chr_second_hand.desc: Lend it to everyone: the party casts 15% faster and runs 15% faster for 10 seconds.

chr_double_time.name: Double Time
chr_double_time.desc: Two bolts in the time of none: {dmg} storm damage twice, instant.

chr_borrowed_time.name: Borrowed Time
chr_borrowed_time.desc: Ten seconds that do not count: you cast 50% faster and hit 20% harder, 50 mana comes back, and a {dmg} ward goes up. The Quicken capstone.

chr_decay.name: Decay
chr_decay.desc: Age the target: {dmg} shadow damage a second for 10 seconds and a 20% slow for 4. Instant; the other filler.

chr_entropy_field.name: Entropy Field
chr_entropy_field.desc: A field 6 m across where you point: for 8 seconds everything in it crawls at 40% slower and rots for {dmg} shadow damage a second. Lands at the pointer.

chr_unravel.name: Unravel
chr_unravel.desc: Pull the thread: {dmg} shadow damage, half again on anything slowed, held or stunned.

chr_wider_field.name: Wider Field
chr_wider_field.desc: Entropy Field covers more ground per rank.

chr_time_rot.name: Time Rot
chr_time_rot.desc: Rot over 5 m round the target: {dmg} shadow damage to everything there, a 30% slow for 3 seconds, and decay on each of them for 6.

chr_heat_death.name: Heat Death
chr_heat_death.desc: The end of everything, 8 m across where you point: {dmg} shadow damage to all of it, half again on the slowed, more the more it hits (up to +40%), a 60% slow for 4 seconds and they hit 20% softer for 6. The Entropy capstone.

chr_stasis_lock.name: Stasis Lock
chr_stasis_lock.desc: Hold the target still for 2 seconds; when it moves again everything lands at once: it takes 25% more from everyone for 6 seconds.

chr_rewind.name: Rewind
chr_rewind.desc: Step back six seconds: {dmg} health back, a ward, every poison, slow and hold undone, and you 6 m back from where you were. Instant.

chr_hiccup.name: Hiccup
chr_hiccup.desc: Skip a beat in the target's clock: stops what it is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} shadow damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

chr_further_back.name: Further Back
chr_further_back.desc: Rewind heals for more per rank.

chr_time_lock.name: Time Lock
chr_time_lock.desc: Lock 5 m of ground where you point: everything in it is held for 2 seconds and takes {dmg} shadow damage. Lands at the pointer.

chr_echo.name: Echo
chr_echo.desc: The hit, and then the hit again: {dmg} shadow damage now and the same spread over the next 4 seconds. Instant.

chr_stop_the_clock.name: Stop the Clock
chr_stop_the_clock.desc: Everything within 10 m stops for 2.5 seconds and takes {dmg} shadow damage, 40 mana comes back, and you cast 30% faster for 8 seconds while they stand there. The Stasis capstone.

spk_mending_post.name: Mending Post
spk_mending_post.desc: Plant a spirit post where you point: everyone standing within 6 m of it, companions too, is healed for {dmg} every second for 15 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

spk_striking_post.name: Striking Post
spk_striking_post.desc: Plant a post that strikes: it stands where it is put for {secs} seconds and throws storm at whatever you fight. Counts as a minion (up to eight).

spk_angrier_post.name: Angrier Post
spk_angrier_post.desc: The Striking Post strikes harder per rank.

spk_rooting_post.name: Rooting Post
spk_rooting_post.desc: A post that holds: for 6 seconds everything within 5 m of it is slowed 40% and stung for {dmg} storm damage a second. Lands at the pointer.

spk_cleansing_post.name: Cleansing Post
spk_cleansing_post.desc: A post that washes: every two seconds for 10, everyone within 6 m of it is healed for {dmg} and their poisons, slows and holds shaken off. Lands at the pointer.

spk_deeper_roots.name: Deeper Roots
spk_deeper_roots.desc: The Mending Post stands longer per rank.

spk_great_post.name: The Great Post
spk_great_post.desc: Plant the Great Post where you point: for 25 seconds it strikes everything you fight, bursts storm over a crowd, and heals everyone within 8 m of it every second. The strike counts as a minion. The Posts capstone.

spk_spirit_bolt.name: Spirit Bolt
spk_spirit_bolt.desc: A bolt of spirit for {dmg} storm damage that jumps to two more foes within 6 m, weaker each jump, and as it leaves you a little light falls on every friend within 10 m. A short cast; your filler.

spk_spirit_lash.name: Spirit Lash
spk_spirit_lash.desc: A lash for {dmg} storm damage that heals you for half of it. Instant.

spk_sharper_bolt.name: Sharper Bolt
spk_sharper_bolt.desc: Spirit Bolt hits harder per rank.

spk_ancestors_word.name: Ancestor's Word
spk_ancestors_word.desc: The old ones say no: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} storm damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

spk_spirit_storm.name: Spirit Storm
spk_spirit_storm.desc: Spirits burst from the target over 5 m: {dmg} storm damage to everything there, more the more it hits (up to +40%), a 30% slow for 2 seconds, and every friend within 10 m of you is healed.

spk_kinder_bolt.name: Kinder Bolt
spk_kinder_bolt.desc: Spirit Bolt's light heals for more per rank.

spk_thousand_spirits.name: A Thousand Spirits
spk_thousand_spirits.desc: Every spirit you know at once: {dmg} storm damage that jumps to five more foes within 7 m, and every friend within 12 m of you is healed and mended for 6 seconds. The Spirit Bolts capstone.

spk_warding_spirits.name: Warding Spirits
spk_warding_spirits.desc: Spirits round everyone: a {dmg} ward on every friend within 10 m for 8 seconds.

spk_spirit_mend.name: Spirit Mend
spk_spirit_mend.desc: {dmg} healing on a friend and a little more each second for 6. A short cast; the plain heal.

spk_stronger_wards.name: Stronger Wards
spk_stronger_wards.desc: Warding Spirits ward for more per rank.

spk_spirit_walk.name: Spirit Walk
spk_spirit_walk.desc: Walk 8 m through the spirit world with a {dmg} ward for 4 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

spk_cleansing_spirit.name: Cleansing Spirit
spk_cleansing_spirit.desc: Shake every poison, slow and hold off a friend, heal them for {dmg}, and heals land 15% harder on them for 8 seconds.

spk_call_back_spirit.name: Call Back the Spirit
spk_call_back_spirit.desc: Call a fallen friend's spirit back whole: they stand at FULL health inside a {dmg} ward. Three seconds of calling; two minutes before you can do it again.

spk_longer_mend.name: Longer Mend
spk_longer_mend.desc: Spirit Mend keeps mending longer per rank.

spk_ancestral_tide.name: Ancestral Tide
spk_ancestral_tide.desc: The ancestors come through all at once: {dmg} healing on every friend within 12 m, mending for 8 seconds after, a ward on each of them, and every ill shaken off. The Calling capstone.

hex_silver_edge.name: Silver Edge
hex_silver_edge.desc: A silvered cut for {mult} weapon damage and a burn of silver on top. Your filler, with blade or crossbow.

hex_silvered_pin.name: Silvered Pin
hex_silvered_pin.desc: A silver pin through the foot: {mult} weapon damage and a 2 second hold.

hex_keener_silver.name: Keener Silver
hex_keener_silver.desc: Silver Edge cuts deeper per rank.

hex_silver_bolt.name: Silver Bolt
hex_silver_bolt.desc: Silver in the throat: {mult} weapon damage, a 1.5 second silence, and the silver burn.

hex_quicksilver.name: Quicksilver
hex_quicksilver.desc: Two quick cuts for {mult} weapon damage each, and +10% critical chance for 6 seconds.

hex_longer_pin.name: Longer Pin
hex_longer_pin.desc: Silvered Pin holds longer per rank.

hex_silver_judgement.name: Silver Judgement
hex_silver_judgement.desc: The sentence: {mult} weapon damage, half again on anything under 35% health, a 2 second silence, and a burn of silver. The Silver capstone.

hex_hush_bolt.name: Hush Bolt
hex_hush_bolt.desc: A bolt that stops the words: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for 1.5, with {mult} weapon damage. From 15 m; does not use the global cooldown.

hex_iron_net.name: Iron Net
hex_iron_net.desc: A net of iron and silver thread over 4 m where you point: everything under it is held and silenced for 2 seconds and cut for {dmg}. Lands at the pointer.

hex_null_circle.name: Null Circle
hex_null_circle.desc: Draw the circle where you point: for 8 seconds nothing standing within 6 m of it can cast, and the silver stings them for {dmg} a second. Lands at the pointer.

hex_wider_circle.name: Wider Circle
hex_wider_circle.desc: Null Circle covers more ground per rank.

hex_silver_dart.name: Silver Dart
hex_silver_dart.desc: A thrown dart for {mult} weapon damage from 15 m; the target hits 15% softer for 6 seconds.

hex_tighter_net.name: Tighter Net
hex_tighter_net.desc: Iron Net holds longer per rank.

hex_dead_silence.name: Dead Silence
hex_dead_silence.desc: Nothing within 8 m speaks: a 3 second silence, a 1 second stun and {dmg} silver damage on all of it, and a {dmg} ward on you. The Null capstone.

hex_writ_of_guilt.name: Writ of Guilt
hex_writ_of_guilt.desc: Name the guilty: {dmg} silver damage, and the target takes 20% more from everyone for 10 seconds. From 20 m.

hex_cleansing_rite.name: Cleansing Rite
hex_cleansing_rite.desc: Shake every poison, slow and hold off a friend and heal them for {dmg}. Instant, from 20 m.

hex_longer_writ.name: Longer Writ
hex_longer_writ.desc: The Writ of Guilt lasts longer per rank.

hex_silver_ward.name: Silver Ward
hex_silver_ward.desc: Silver thread under the mail: a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds that cuts back at whatever hits you, and +15% armour.

hex_hunters_call.name: Hunter's Call
hex_hunters_call.desc: Send the whole party after one: the target takes 10% more from everyone for 10 seconds and every friend hits 10% harder for 10. From 20 m.

hex_kinder_rite.name: Kinder Rite
hex_kinder_rite.desc: Cleansing Rite heals for more per rank.

hex_rite_of_purging.name: Rite of Purging
hex_rite_of_purging.desc: The rite over everything within 8 m: {dmg} silver damage to every foe there, more the more it hits (up to +40%), a 2 second silence and they hit 20% softer for 6; every friend there is healed and every ill shaken off. The Writ capstone.

mnk_open_palm.name: Open Palm
mnk_open_palm.desc: A palm strike for {mult} weapon damage that builds poise: +3% damage for 8 seconds, and every different strike adds its own. Your filler.

mnk_wind_step.name: Wind Step
mnk_wind_step.desc: Step 8 m to the target on the wind, and for 3 seconds every hit is a sure critical. Poise.

mnk_firmer_palm.name: Firmer Palm
mnk_firmer_palm.desc: Open Palm hits harder per rank.

mnk_twin_palms.name: Twin Palms
mnk_twin_palms.desc: Both palms, one after the other, for {mult} weapon damage each. Poise.

mnk_flying_knee.name: Flying Knee
mnk_flying_knee.desc: The knee, in the air: {mult} weapon damage and a 1 second stun. Poise.

mnk_second_palm.name: Second Palm
mnk_second_palm.desc: Twin Palms hit harder per rank.

mnk_hundred_palms.name: Hundred Palms
mnk_hundred_palms.desc: Five strikes in a breath for {mult} weapon damage each, and +10% damage for 10 seconds on top of your poise. The Open Palm capstone.

mnk_inner_stillness.name: Inner Stillness
mnk_inner_stillness.desc: Find the still centre: +20% armour and +10 dodge while it holds, at -5% damage. Press again to let it go. Your slots do not change.

mnk_still_breath.name: Still Breath
mnk_still_breath.desc: One breath: {dmg} health back and every poison, slow and hold shaken off. Instant.

mnk_iron_body.name: Iron Body
mnk_iron_body.desc: The body as a wall: a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds that strikes back at whatever hits you, and +20% armour.

mnk_harder_body.name: Harder Body
mnk_harder_body.desc: Iron Body wards for more per rank.

mnk_calm_centre.name: Calm Centre
mnk_calm_centre.desc: A touch to the throat: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {mult} weapon damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

mnk_still_mountain.name: Still Mountain
mnk_still_mountain.desc: Be the mountain for 10 seconds: a {dmg} ward that strikes back hard, +40% armour, a heal for yourself, and everything within 6 m turns on you and is slowed. The Stillness capstone.

mnk_sweeping_heel.name: Sweeping Heel
mnk_sweeping_heel.desc: A heel through a 120 degree arc: {mult} weapon damage to everything in it and a 30% slow for 3 seconds. Poise.

mnk_staff_line.name: Staff Line
mnk_staff_line.desc: The staff straight out, 8 m: {mult} weapon damage to everything on the line and a half-second stun. Poise.

mnk_mountain_fist.name: Mountain Fist
mnk_mountain_fist.desc: The whole mountain behind one fist: {mult} weapon damage and a 1.5 second stun. Poise.

mnk_wider_heel.name: Wider Heel
mnk_wider_heel.desc: Sweeping Heel reaches further per rank.

mnk_leg_sweep.name: Leg Sweep
mnk_leg_sweep.desc: Low and fast: {mult} weapon damage to everything within 4 m and a 1.5 second hold. Poise.

mnk_heavier_fist.name: Heavier Fist
mnk_heavier_fist.desc: Mountain Fist hits harder per rank.

mnk_longer_line.name: Longer Line
mnk_longer_line.desc: Staff Line reaches further per rank.

mnk_ninefold_staff.name: Ninefold Staff
mnk_ninefold_staff.desc: The staff in a widening spin: {mult} weapon damage to everything within 6 m, more the more it hits (up to +50%), a 1 second stun, and every strike of poise you have built counts on each hit. The Ninefold capstone.

wishlist.field: rewind (back to where and how you were)
wishlist.rule: `rewind: { secs: 6 }`: the sim keeps a 6 s ring of (x, z, hp, mana) per hero and puts the caster back to the oldest entry. Written today as a self-heal + ward + cleanse + 6 m back, which reads as the same thing.

wishlist.field: stasis (damage held, then landed at once)
wishlist.rule: `stasis: { secs: 2 }` on a stun: damage dealt to the target while it holds is banked and applied the moment it ends. Written today as a 2 s stun + a 25% mark for 6 s (more damage after, not banked damage).
`cond: { family: ['restless', 'caster'], mult: 1.3 }` on a damage/weapon effect: x mult when the target's monster family or role matches. Flat today; the silver burn is a plain physical add.
`nextHitCrit: true` consumed by the next weapon hit. Written today as `buff crit 100% 3 s`, which makes every hit in those three seconds a critical rather than one.
As wave 2's Grandeur: `flair: { perSkill: 0.15, max: 5, window: 8 }`. Poise today is the per-skill +3% damage buffs read through fxPct, which is the same counter at a flat rate.

`elementFrom: 'stance'` on a damage effect would let ONE Breath / ONE Flask take its element from the held temper or a toggle. Written today as two skills each, which also gives each its own cooldown.

wishlist.field: minions standing still and the brain
wishlist.rule: A stationary minion only fights what comes within its reach + 0.6 m (allies.js stepAllies); a ranged sentry's reach is 11 m, a bait sentry's 1.7 m. Rule worth keeping: a `stay` minion with a taunt should shout at its radius, not its reach.
